                                      Resolution 2025-07
                        Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors

                Support for the Site Plan for a Pavilion in Lions Club Park

   WHEREAS, Planning Case 2025-0064 Administrative Site Plan Review for pavilion construction in Lions Club Park in
   Girdwood is scheduled for decision June 13, 2025; and

   WHEREAS, the effort to build a pavilion has been supported within the community and by the Girdwood Turnagain Arm
    Lions Club for many years; and

   WHEREAS, approval of the Site Plan will allow the Girdwood Valley Service Area to move forward with planned
    construction, perhaps as early as Summer 2025.

   THEREFORE the Girdwood Board of Supervisors resolves its support for the Case 2025-0064, Administrative Site Plan
    for a pavilion to be located in Girdwood Lions Club Park, Lot 3, Block 1, First Addition Girdwood Townsite, Alaska
    Subd. (Plat 66-76).

    Passed and approved by the Girdwood Board of Supervisors by a vote of 4 in favor and 0 opposed on this 19th day of
   May 2025.




    Brian Burnett                                            Attest
   GBOS Parks and Recreation Supervisor
